class.name: NNBTPassBy
class.brief_description: Runs an optional user-defined [code]on_tick(delta)[/code] method and always returns [constant NNBTNodes.SUCCESS].
class.description: The PassBy node runs an optional user-defined [code]on_tick(delta)[/code] method, ignores any value it returns, and always returns [constant NNBTNodes.SUCCESS] to its parent. Inside an [NNBTSequence] this lets execution continue to the next child, making it useful for running side-effect logic as a step in a sequence (similar to [NNBTPassThrough], without wrapping a child). Inside an [NNBTSelector], however, returning [constant NNBTNodes.SUCCESS] short-circuits the selector and completes it immediately, so later children are not ticked. The method receives only [code]delta[/code] for the tick; the node's data lives in the effective blackboard of the nearest [NNBTRoot] ancestor.
